boundary: Generated after the frozen E2E-90 run and before reference-answer scoring. Inputs are limited to lifecycle/protocol/action/obligation/witness/proof/state analysis artifacts. No external_passed, passed, verifier observation, final answer, reference answer, or standard answer is read.

blind_causal_conclusion.safety_effect: The pre-registered risk class was absent from proof-pass assertions while read-only same-target snapshots remained eligible.
blind_causal_conclusion.amplification_effect: The same provenance rejection was retried 49 times across 8 cases. The local revision/replan path did not reliably change the observation or expected-source lineage, so a narrow safety rejection became repeated model work and obligation growth rather than producer correction.
system_chain: RWKV selects and executes producer actions, including workspace mutation.
RWKV later binds an expected source that can descend from that mutation.
The proof engine correctly rejects model-written same-target circular provenance.
Local witness revision often selects the same semantic lineage again.
Obligation replan appends semantically duplicated work until budget exhaustion.
blind_causal_conclusion.next_hypothesis_not_implemented: For deterministic workspace proofs only, cache an observation/proof-failure digest. If evidence, verifier, criterion, and failure fingerprint are unchanged, consume recovery budget without rerunning the same proof/RWKV cross-check and route recovery toward producer correction. External or time-varying observations must remain uncached.
